bundle.shortDescription: A modern desktop client for SSH, SFTP/SCP, and S3
bundle.longDescription: OmniSSH is a free, open-source desktop application that combines an SSH terminal, SFTP/SCP file explorer, and S3-compatible cloud storage browser into a single, fast, privacy-first tool. Built with Tauri v2, it runs natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
